scope: Native Tianxuan local CLI/API provider reuse, isolated runtime lifecycle, identity/cancellation, local persistence and storage-only synchronization, native chat/design UI integration, unchanged Web conversation route compatibility. Follow-up review includes native HTTP fixture/runner and probes, source-contract integration into default native-shell CI, and explicitly opted-in real Codex probe.

findings.problem: Lost local-turn ACK could never reconcile normalized content/context because the client compared raw fields.
findings.resolution: Client always replays persisted original outbox payload; server verifies normalized immutable digest and returns existing turn without another inference or version bump.

findings.problem: Design generation omitted confirmed predecessor content and accepted result after source revisions changed.
findings.resolution: Confirmed predecessor content is sent; current/revisions/requirement_id and original local draft are frozen and checked before applying completion.

findings.problem: Full-body model replacement could overwrite authored design paragraphs.
findings.resolution: Model is instructed to supplement, and the controller appends bounded returned text while preserving the original body exactly.

findings.problem: Optional real CLI runner recorded read-only/no-shell/ScriptError conditions without requiring them for success.
findings.resolution: probe_passed requires all observed process and isolation conditions; independently checked existing receipt acceptance, eight altered-condition rejection cases, and opt-in rejection before executable resolution without another provider call.
